project_name: ArenaHub - Plataforma de Gestão de Torneios e Competições
design_principles: Tactical Precision: High contrast dark theme with neon emerald/gold signals for active competition states.
Bento Grid Energy: Asymmetric cards for featured tournaments, quick stats, and live match ticker.
Fluid Micro-Interactions: Smooth bracket pan, interactive team draw (sorteio) with shuffle animation, springy button feedback.
Brazilian Sports Tone: Focused on Futevôlei, Beach Tennis, Futebol de Sabão, Padel, and Volleyball with local payment methods (PIX QR Code & Cartão de Crédito).

typography.font_family_body: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

visual_enhancers.card_style: bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl transition-all duration-300 hover:border-emerald-500/40 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-emerald-500/5

layout_and_grids.hero_layout: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-center py-12 lg:py-20
layout_and_grids.bracket_grid: flex flex-row overflow-x-auto gap-8 py-6 min-w-full scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-slate-700

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a cohesive React application in Portuguese (Brazil) following all specified components and Brazilian tournament workflows.
Use Tailwind CSS utility classes matching the dark tactical palette (#0B0F17 base, emerald/amber accents).
Ensure all interactive buttons, forms, tabs, dropdowns, and cards include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., data-testid='competition-card-1', data-testid='register-button-pix').
Implement rich mock state (localStorage backed) so that created competitions, registered duplas, payments, draw results, and bracket scores persist seamlessly across page navigations.
Support social login simulation (Google / Facebook) and instant admin toggle for easy testing of admin features.
Do NOT use transparent dropdown backgrounds or plain white default inputs. Maintain high contrast.
